description:
Scroll like video. Play like a game.
Every choice rewrites the story and unlocks a different ending. This isn't watching — it's playing.

Yoroll is a Playable Video platform — every video is a story you can play your way into.
Don't just scroll. Every choice you make changes where the story goes and which ending you reach. Swipe to start, finish a story in minutes, and the deeper you play, the more the story becomes yours.
From mystery and survival to palace intrigue, there's something new every day. You've watched enough of everyone else's videos — come play your own.
Play, choose, change the story.

Need help or have feedback? Reach us at support@lineargame.ai
Privacy Policy: https://docs.yoroll.ai/yoroll-privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://docs.yoroll.ai/yoroll-term-of-use
